title: US data breach compromises, per year
notes: Number of publicly reported US data compromise events (companies/organizations breached) tracked each year by ITRC. 2021: 1,862 (a record at the time). 2022: 1,802. 2023: 3,202 (new record). 2024: 3,158 (a slight dip from 2023). 2025: 3,322, a new all-time record, up 79% over the prior five years.
